So the list pages pass nrcheck only on nav junk ("3", "4", "39", "{javascript:", "Launch Vehicle Fleet", "Kinetica-1 Launcher"). These are not real posts, so I did not report them as working. The sitemap fallback also fails. https://www.cas-space.com/sitemap.xml has 69 /article/NN.html entries, but they look stale (the highest is about 65), and the paths have no news/press segment, so NEWSY rejects them. There is no RSS or Atom feed: /rss.xml and /feed/ return 404, and the listing has no alternate link. Nothing blocked the fetches. To make this work, the scraper would need to accept /article/\d+ links from a /list/ page (for example, by accepting a news listing whose post links share a common sibling path).
